Senses.Explanation: Qianfeng's rule of one: raise one thing only — let a move pass and you have landed in second place. Yunmen answered it with yesterday's traveler from Tiantai bound for Jingshan, and the records keep asking how the one is raised at all. The case and its teeth: Tianyin Yuanxiu raises it whole — Qianfeng's line, Yunmen stepping out of the crowd with the traveler's news from Tiantai to Jingshan, Qianfeng calling the dean to bar the kitchen steward from community work tomorrow; Dahui Zonggao, asked its point, answers with a winter melon hung on a camel's tail; Shiyu Mingfang at the winter solstice rules that Qianfeng was seeing the guest off with one hand while holding him back with the other, and Yunmen could only go with the waves. The rule in live hands: Miyun Yuanwu opens a hall address with it — the whole earth says today is the first of the seventh month; now, brothers, how do you raise it? Raise it right and every being's life on the whole earth is right here; Tianran Hanshi lifts the whisk and sets the terms: call it the first and you have long since fallen to second, call it the second and there can be no further first; Lianfeng Su takes it as the opener at the furnace-lighting and adds that two comes from one but the one must not be kept either — the Pearl-wave pagoda and the husband-watching pagoda butt brows with not a hair of high or low, Dongshi aping Xishi; Baichi Xingyuan cites his own grand-master Miyun dropping the staff on this very line — fallen to second, and how would you raise the one? Shrimping to catch turtles; Jinian Jingxian raises the pair over tea at the retreat's closing night.
